description: Na₂SeMoO₆ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.47 Å) and three longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.38 Å) and three longer (2.62 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (1.79 Å) and three longer (2.24 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. Se is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Se-O bond lengths are 1.74 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mo, and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom.
